findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler inherits StatefulDetectorHandler but does not implement its abstract counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, or build_occurrence_and_event_data members. Accessing detector.detector_handler for a metric_alert_fire detector therefore raises TypeError at handler construction, and process_detectors aborts instead of returning no results as the previous placeholder did. Keep a concrete no-op handler until the stateful implementation is available, or implement the required members.

findings.title: Expected occurrence uses a different group key from the evaluation
findings.body: TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe builds its expected occurrence with group key "val1", but evaluates group key "group_key". The mock occurrence builder includes the group key in the occurrence fingerprint, so the expected fingerprint is ["<detector_id>:val1"] while the returned occurrence has ["<detector_id>:group_key"]. The equality assertion consequently fails even when the implementation is correct. Build the expected occurrence using "group_key".
